name: RTS Action Replay
description: Capture OBS replay-buffer clips and play them through a Streamer.bot-controlled browser overlay.

website.footerLabel: Part of The Road to Somewhere.

experience.title: Turn OBS replay clips into an interactive on-stream replay player.
experience.text: RTS Action Replay connects OBS Replay Buffer captures, Streamer.bot and a remote browser overlay so saved clips can be loaded and controlled without a separate web server.

features.title: OBS replay buffer
features.text: Trigger OBS to save the current replay buffer from Streamer.bot.

features.title: Local replay serving
features.text: Use Streamer.bot's HTTP server to expose replay files to the overlay.

features.title: Playlist ready
features.text: Keep saved replays available for previous and next playback control.

features.title: Remote overlay
features.text: Host the player on The Road to Somewhere while the video files remain local.

requirements: Streamer.bot with its WebSocket and HTTP servers enabled.
RtsUI.dll for the extension settings interface.

setup.title: Get Action Replay running.
setup.intro: Import the Streamer.bot actions, enable the required services, configure OBS Replay Buffer and the local HTTP file mapping, then add the overlay to OBS.

steps.title: Import the extension into Streamer.bot
steps.description: Open Streamer.bot and use Import to paste the supplied import string, or download the latest import file and import it into Streamer.bot.

substeps.title: Copy the import string
substeps.text: Look above for Action Import and click [[code:Copy Import]]. Paste the import code into Streamer.bot's Import dialog.

substeps.title: Open Import
substeps.text: Select Import from the Streamer.bot toolbar.

substeps.title: Paste the import code
substeps.text: Paste the supplied import string into the Import String box, then select Import.

substeps.title: Confirm the import
substeps.text: Review the actions being imported, then select Import to continue.

steps.title: Enable the imported actions
steps.description: Enable the imported RTS Action Replay actions and commands so the extension can respond to events and chat commands.

substeps.title: Enable the extension actions
substeps.text: Enable the imported RTS Action Replay actions in Streamer.bot.

substeps.title: Check the commands
substeps.text: Confirm the imported RTS Action Replay commands are present and enabled where required.

steps.title: Enable OBS Replay Buffer
steps.description: Enable Replay Buffer in OBS and choose the folder where the replay files are saved.

substeps.title: Enable Replay Buffer
substeps.text: In OBS, open Settings > Output and enable Replay Buffer.

substeps.title: Choose the replay folder
substeps.text: Configure OBS to save replay files to a folder that Streamer.bot can access. You will use this same folder when configuring the HTTP Server mapping and RTS Action Replay settings.

steps.title: Configure the Streamer.bot HTTP Server
steps.description: The hosted RTS overlay cannot read files directly from your computer. Streamer.bot's HTTP Server provides the local URL that the overlay uses to load replay video files.

substeps.title: Enable the HTTP Server
substeps.text: In Streamer.bot, open the Servers or Web Server settings and enable the HTTP Server. Keep note of the HTTP port.

substeps.title: Add a file mapping
substeps.text: Create a file or directory mapping for the OBS Replay Buffer folder. Use a simple URL path such as [[code:replays]] and point it to the same local folder where OBS saves replay files.

substeps.title: Check the mapping
substeps.text: The mapping should expose the replay folder through the Streamer.bot HTTP Server. For example, a replay file named [[code:Replay 001.mp4]] in the mapped folder should be available below the [[code:/replays/]] path.

substeps.title: Keep the HTTP server available
substeps.text: Leave the Streamer.bot HTTP Server running while using Action Replay. The overlay uses this service to request the local replay video.

steps.title: Enable the Streamer.bot WebSocket
steps.description: The hosted overlay uses the Streamer.bot WebSocket to receive Action Replay events and commands.

substeps.title: Enable the WebSocket Server
substeps.text: In Streamer.bot, open the WebSocket Server settings and enable the server. Keep the configured port available to the overlay.

substeps.title: Keep WebSocket access available
substeps.text: The Streamer.bot WebSocket Server must remain running while the Action Replay overlay is in use.

steps.title: Configure RTS Action Replay
steps.description: Open the RTS Action Replay settings and configure the replay source and local HTTP mapping.

substeps.title: Open the settings dialog
substeps.text: In the Streamer.bot Actions panel, run the RTS Action Replay settings action to open the extension settings.

substeps.title: Configure the OBS replay folder
substeps.text: Set the replay folder to the same directory used by OBS Replay Buffer.

substeps.title: Configure the HTTP mapping
substeps.text: Set the HTTP path and related local serving settings to match the Streamer.bot HTTP Server mapping you created in the previous step.

substeps.title: Save the settings
substeps.text: Save the extension settings before testing replay creation and playback.

substeps.title: Automatic installation of RtsUI.dll
substeps.text: If you do not have the DLL installed, the extension can download and place it in your Streamer.bot installation directory.

substeps.title: Automatic updating of RtsUI.dll
substeps.text: If the extension requires an updated version, it can ask whether you want to download and install the latest version.

steps.title: Add the Action Replay overlay to OBS
steps.description: Add the hosted Action Replay overlay as an OBS Browser Source.

substeps.title: Copy the Overlay URL
substeps.text: Look above in the Quick Access section and click [[code:Copy Overlay URL]]. This copies the overlay URL to your clipboard for use in OBS.

substeps.title: Create a browser source
substeps.text: Add a Browser Source to the scene where you want Action Replay to appear.

substeps.title: Configure the browser source
substeps.text: Paste the overlay URL into the URL field and set the Browser Source dimensions to 1920x1080, or another 16:9 size. The Action Replay overlay uses a 1920x1080 coordinate system. Enable Refresh browser when scene becomes active if required by your scene setup.

steps.title: Test Action Replay
steps.description: Create a replay and confirm that the complete local-to-overlay path is working.

substeps.title: Save a replay
substeps.text: Use the Action Replay Save Replay command or the configured OBS Replay Buffer action to create a replay file.

substeps.title: Confirm the replay is available
substeps.text: Check that the replay file appears in the configured replay folder and is reachable through the Streamer.bot HTTP mapping.

substeps.title: Play the replay
substeps.text: Use the Action Replay playback command or Playlist controls and confirm the video appears in the OBS overlay.

notes: Replay files remain on the local computer. The RTS overlay does not upload them to the website.
The production overlay is hosted by The Road to Somewhere; Streamer.bot supplies the local WebSocket and HTTP services.
